prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Houston, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1031; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement today. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd prefer to keep my name off this one, if that's alright. You can refer to me as the driver of the gray sedan.
Q: That works for the file. Can you tell me where the collision occurred?
A: It was on a main road in Houston, Texas, near a shopping center. Traffic had slowed down ahead of me, so I was stopped at the light.
Q: What happened next?
A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. The car behind me didn't stop in time and hit my rear bumper.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did you notice any injuries right after the impact?
A: Not right away. I got out, looked at the car, and felt fine for a few minutes. By that evening my lower back was stiff and sore.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment?
A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic the next day. They diagnosed me with a back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to a physical therapist.
Q: Are you still experiencing pain?
A: Yes, it's better than it was, but I still get sharp pain when I bend over or sit too long. I've had to take time off from some of my usual activities.
Q: Did you have any pain or back problems before this collision?
A: No, not that I can recall. My back had been fine.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'll send over the clinic paperwork when I get it.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
